messages:
anya: Quick sync 11 finalizing rollout plan for routes.payment.v2. Customer-driven launch; need ops slots + auto-rollback thresholds.
kevin: SGTM. Start canary in one AZ (us-west-2) then regional ramp?
anya: Proposed 3 phases: 1) canary us-west-2 1% for 1h, 2) warmup us-west-2 + us-east-1 5% for 6h, 3) staged ramp to 25% then to 100% over 48h if stable.
marcus: Abort criteria suggestion: auto-rollback if error-rate > 2x baseline for 5m OR p95 latency +200ms for 5m. Immediate rollback if customer-visible 5xx spike >0.5% of requests.
jordan: Add A/B signals: payment_success_rate and downstream conversion delta. Block >25% until 95% CI on key metric passes.
linda: Sales request: platinum customers want early opt-in. Need per-tenant opt-in flags + 24h blackout opt-out window.
anya: Plan: flag default OFF, controlled opt-in cohort for early adopters.
kevin: Feature-flag payload example: ```
{"flag":"routes.payment.v2_enabled","strategies":[{"scope":"region","region":"us-west-2","pct":1},{"scope":"tenant","tenant_id":"T-PLAT-123","pct":100}],"kill_conditions":{"error_rate_mult":2.0,"p95_ms":200}}
```
marcus: Ops slots: two 2-hour watch windows week1 (09:00-11:00 PT, 14:00-16:00 PT). Pager to oncall + runbook link.
anya: Runbook RB-2026-42 (Ill create). Auto-postmortem trigger on rollback.
kevin: Fallback: on rollback route to routes.payment.v1 and mark flag state "failed-canary" for 24h.
jordan: Also run 2-week A/B at 15% for non-payment flows to detect downstream regressions. Tag telemetry.
linda: Add manual "pause" button in admin console so customers can opt-out quickly. Need product+security sign-off.
marcus: Preflight checklist: smoke tests green; dashboards (error-rate, p50/p95/p99, success-rate); alerts wired; inhibit rollout if infra CPU >80%.
anya: Gate for phase 2: errors <= baseline, p95 <=1.2x baseline, zero customer escalations, experiment telemetry OK.
kevin: Timeline: Day0 canary 1h; Day0-1 warmup 6h; Day1-3 staged to 25%; Day3-5 full ramp if stable.
anya: Owners: ops owns canary decision; product+eng approve regional ramp. Need approvers listed in runbook.
linda: Will send platinum CSV by EOD.
jordan: Will publish experiment dashboard and block >25% if insufficient samples.
marcus: I'll add automation to flip flag to fallback on kill_conditions and notify #incidents via deploy-bot.
deploy-bot: Automated rollback configured once kill_conditions enabled. Will post state changes to channel. :robot_face:
anya: Next steps: I will create RB-2026-42, kevin will open feature-flag PR, marcus will confirm alerts+automation, jordan will wire metrics, linda will deliver CSV. Aim to start canary Fri 09:00 PT.
kevin: PR by tomorrow AM.
marcus: Alerts live now.
anya: Thanks all 11 posting this as canonical plan. Ping me in-thread for updates. :white_check_mark:
